reason: User-supplied cookie value flows directly into bar via URL decoding, then becomes input bytes which are converted back to a String and passed to ESAPI.encodeForHTML() before being written to the HTTP response. The guard condition (500/42)+num>200 evaluates to true, allowing the full user input to reach the XSS sink without effective filtering.
